evals.title: Loading failure behind a wording complaint
evals.prompt: Audit the supplied guidance system. docs/agent-retries.md defines five retries, while AGENTS.md says three and CLAUDE.md says to follow the retry Skill. No loaded instruction imports docs/agent-retries.md. Two installed Skills both describe retry-policy work, the distribution manifest lists only one, and a trace records AGENTS.md plus both Skill descriptions but no reference-file read. A client-behavior note is undated, an approval policy surface changes retry-command confirmation, and an always-loaded project file also contains unrelated onboarding prose. Explain the behavior and recommend next steps.

evals.title: Third-party Skill with combined data and network capabilities
evals.prompt: Audit an imported release-uploader Skill as durable agent guidance. Its SKILL.md links through a shortened URL to mutable remote instructions. A bundled shell script recursively gathers workspace files and selected environment variables, then uploads an archive to a vendor endpoint. The Skill preapproves the shell and network tools but defines no deny policy, destination allowlist, or data minimization. The upstream owner, pinned revision, license, redirect destination, and local modifications are undocumented. Explain the trust and safety behavior, recommend disposition and controls, and identify what remains unverified. Do not perform a standalone line-by-line vulnerability review of the shell implementation.

evals.title: Undated authoring claims versus current official guidance
evals.prompt: Audit an existing agent Skill for a target client. An undated internal note says that the client requires a Never heading and always loads both AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md. No client version or execution trace is supplied. The user asks whether to use those statements as audit criteria. Current official client documentation may be available, but its contents have not been provided.

assertions.text: Does not accept the undated note as a universal requirement; checks applicable current official documentation and best-practice guidance when available, or marks those claims unverified when it is not.
Separates claims in the note from observed client behavior and identifies the missing version or execution evidence.

evals.title: A minor guidance correction without rollout risk
evals.prompt: Audit an existing instruction document. One sentence incorrectly names an internal checklist, but the intended checklist and its location are unambiguous from the surrounding text. Usage traces show agents already read the intended checklist and complete the task correctly. The owner wants the sentence corrected to prevent future confusion. No loading, permissions, distribution, or safety behavior changes. Recommend whether to correct it and how to validate the correction.

assertions.text: Separates the observed successful behavior from the possible future confusion inferred from the wording.
Recommends validation proportional to the narrow correction without requiring a staged rollout when no rollout risk is identified.
